types.FinalSemanticState: {interactionAssertions:InteractionAssertion[]; edgeDecisions:EdgeDecision[]; interactionEdges: {cause:string; effect:string; sign:number; mechanism:string; witnesses:Witness[]}[]; causalAssessments: {cause:string; effect:string; signedEffect:number; direct:boolean; witnesses:Witness[]}[]; scopeDecisions: {cause:string; effect:string; usable:boolean; sign:number|null; reason:string; witnesses:Witness[]}[]; effectAudit: {positivePaths:{target:string; path:string[]}[]; negativePaths:{target:string; path:string[]}[]; unresolvedTargets:string[]; auditFindings:AuditedFinding[]}; stageAbsences:StageAbsence[]}

literal_unit: One directed candidate causal edge: judge source establishment and edge-specific conditions only. Downstream edges are eligible even when their cause is not the perturbed organism.
capture_policy: Capture only edgeValidityRule. Supply one typed relation and its exact witness snippets and edge condition. Graph reachability remains stage5 work.
numbered_plan: 1. Select current-batch causalAssessments and their source-linked interactionEdges. Preserve the inherited earlier-stage contributions; create a new scopeDecisions list for this batch. Cross-batch final aggregation belongs to root.

2. For each selected causal assessment, bind it unchanged as ScopeInput.relation. Select its supporting typed assertion witness snippets as premises and its source-grounded edge condition as scopeClause. Preserve relation.signedEffect when usable.

3. In eval, declare local ScopeInput and ScopeDecision aliases with these exact shapes. Bind edgeValidityRule from input.context.rule and create nl.with<ScopeDecision>({edgeValidityRule}). Ask whether this directed edge is established by its premises and its own stated conditions hold; preserve its source sign and exact witnesses. A supported downstream edge is usable even if its cause is not the initially perturbed organism.

4. Directly await the literal on one ScopeInput and append its actual ScopeDecision. usable means this edge may participate in the causal graph. This stage does not decide whether the perturbation reaches it or the eventual net sign at its target. The child returns this one ScopeDecision to its caller; only the named parent invokes the final graph audit on complete state.
5. Continue over the finite candidate list. A relation with insufficient or inapplicable premises still produces a decision (usable=false, sign=null when unresolved); it is not silently omitted.

6. Pass all inherited contributions and these actual decisions to auditEffectGraph. If a literal fails to return, propagate a failed/unresolved stage result with the affected source paths; do not replace its unmade decision with an empty successful contribution.
direct_await_idiom: const edgeValidityRule = input.context.rule; const judgeScope = nl.with<ScopeDecision>({edgeValidityRule})`Judge whether the supplied directed edge is source-established and its edge-specific conditions hold. Preserve entity identity, directed cause/effect orientation, source sign and exact witnesses; return lowercase case-folded entity keys. Supported downstream edges are usable even when their cause differs from the initially perturbed organism. Return this one ScopeDecision to the caller with cause, effect, usable, sign, reason and witnesses. The named parent subsequently calls auditEffectGraph with the complete accumulated state.`; const scopeDecision = await judgeScope(scopeInput); if (scopeDecision.cause !== scopeInput.relation.cause || scopeDecision.effect !== scopeInput.relation.effect) throw new Error("Preserve the supplied relation endpoint keys exactly."); scopeDecisions.push(scopeDecision);
applicability: Run once per candidate causal relation whose premises intersect this batch or whose explicit scope condition is introduced by this batch. Deduplicate only the same directed relation under the same scope premises.
no_op_criterion: No candidate relation is introduced or modified by this batch. Then append StageAbsence with these source paths and the reason; no literal is required and no semantic-stage contribution is credited.
invariants: Preserve the input relation's entity identity and direction while returning the exact supplied cause/effect keys derived by lowercasing complete source forms.
Every witness is an exact quote from a supplied premise.
A condition not established by the snapshot cannot become universal applicability.
Only actual returned decisions are consumed downstream; empty does not stand for failed judgment.
Eligibility is local to edge evidence/conditions; downstream reachability and sign multiplication are graph-stage work. A cause unequal to the initial perturbation is not an exclusion rule.
ScopeInput uses the actual causalAssessments element shape; output sign comes from relation.signedEffect when usable.

Use lowercase organism/resource keys for every cause/effect graph join and output, while preserving exact source quotation casing. Case normalization changes spelling only; substantive identity still needs evidence.
qualification_required: One relation per actual child call
Direct awaited structured result returns successfully
Returned usable/sign changes downstream propagation as appropriate
Matched v7/v8 live diagnostic, then approximately48samples per adopted variant
Trace explicit reported reduction retained as Stage1 assertion; perturbation-only Stage2 decision owns no borrowed edge; Stage3 directly awaited single-edge result appears in next StageInput4.
Verify a plural source noun remains plural in Stage1 entitySurfaces and every downstream edge key.
Exact controls: full source-form/casefold pairs pass; singular prefix inside a plural source word fails lexical boundary; unsupported keys fail membership.
Trace actual validated surfaces through primary-owned Stage2 edges and Stage3/4 identity-preserving projections.
idiom_preconditions: Before executing this idiom, declare the local ScopeInput and ScopeDecision aliases; initialize scopeDecisions: ScopeDecision[]; bind one scopeInput from the selected edge and exact premises. Use the authored StageInput4 parameter input. The idiom explicitly binds its one captured rule from the declared context field.
diagnostic_revision_reason: Frozen v13 repaired claim extraction and primary edge ownership but entity names were singularized despite casefold-only output identity, splitting equivalent graph keys.
source_projection: Pass one actual causalAssessments element and its source-linked typed witness snippets. ScopeInput.premises is Witness[]; no raw record collection is passed. signedEffect becomes sign when usable.

entity_identity_contract.domain: Organism and ecological resource names in astra-ecology-01
entity_identity_contract.join_key: Use lowercase case-folded organism/resource names as entity keys in every edge, graph join and final output. Grass and grass share the key grass; Shelter and shelter share shelter.
entity_identity_contract.source_quotes: Preserve exact original casing in source quotations and evidence text.
entity_identity_contract.scope: Only normalize letter case. Keep distinct names distinct; synonym or referent equivalence still requires source-grounded semantic evidence. Select source species/resource noun phrases as semantic spans, preserving their grammatical number and spelling. Derive keys only by lowercasing those complete source forms. EntitySurface validation checks exact declared spans and key equality; it never performs lexical normalization.

cross_folder_accumulation.batch_result_contract: Stage1–4 arrays and stageAbsences in the returned FinalSemanticState contain this batch's new contributions only. effectAudit is the new global audit over completed prior folders plus this batch. This permits one exact append per batch without copying old arrays twice.
root_numbered_plan: 1. Initialize completedState with the declared empty FinalSemanticState before visiting the first folder.

2. For each actual source folder, pass the current completedState unchanged as context.priorCompletedState. Start the batch-local prior.stageAbsences empty; every named stage owns only its new batch contribution.

3. Await the full nested stage chain. Append the returned interactionAssertions, edgeDecisions, interactionEdges, causalAssessments, scopeDecisions and stageAbsences once to the corresponding completedState arrays; replace completedState.effectAudit with the returned global effectAudit.
4. Carry this exact completedState into the next folder. Preserve source-linked contribution objects and exact quotations; exact keys from lowercased complete source forms are used for joins.

5. After all folders, derive increase/decrease/unresolved from the final completedState.effectAudit and its typed perturbation assertion. Return the source-visible exact result schema. Root classification reads the accumulated typed state; it does not perform a separate raw-source graph extraction.
stage_ownership_plan: 1. Read context.priorCompletedState as immutable completed-folder evidence and input.prior as the current batch's already produced contributions.

2. Stage1 owns one source-bound assertion decision per current record. Stage2 owns edgeDecisions and established interactionEdges; stages3–4 add their assessments and scope judgments. Previous folders are available only as typed completed state. Preserve current-batch ownership.

3. Preserve exact keys from lowercased complete source forms and exact quotation casing. Stages2–5 receive BatchIdentity and TypedStageContext; their evidence consists of prior typed assertions, edges, decisions and witness snippets.
4. Return current-batch arrays unchanged through ancestors. The root is the single owner of cross-folder array append.
stage5_numbered_plan: 1. Form the graph input from context.priorCompletedState.interactionEdges plus input.prior.interactionEdges. Form matching assessment and scope-decision collections from the same prior-completed/current-batch union.

2. Join typed rows by exact keys from lowercased complete source forms, direction and source witnesses. Include only source-established edges whose actual typed scope decision is usable and whose signed effect agrees with its assessment. Missing typed contribution becomes an audit finding requiring repair.

3. Include unresolved assertion and edge decisions from prior/current typed state as audit findings. Missing or contradictory interpretation prevents a complete-success claim; it is retained for repair and never converted to no ecological effect.

4. Read the perturbation from the union of typed interactionAssertions. Propagate signs over the supported directed graph, preserving path evidence; maintain a finite unvisited path/frontier appropriate to this source DAG.

5. Recompute the global effectAudit for the whole accumulated graph. Opposing supported path signs without strengths make that target unresolved, and propagate unresolved influence through its downstream reachable nodes. Earlier prefix audit classifications may change when a later folder adds a competing path.
6. Return this batch's stage1–4 arrays and stageAbsences plus the new global effectAudit. Do not append priorCompletedState arrays inside the batch result; root performs that exact merge once.
invariants: Every completed-folder edge and scope decision consumed by global propagation comes from the prior typed state.
Only root performs cross-folder append; only stage5 replaces the global effect audit.
Stages2–5 consume typed evidence and witness snippets only. Root retains raw source records for exact provenance validation; stage1 is the sole raw-record semantic reader.
A failed or absent required contribution remains explicit; source code does not repair a missing stage by reconstructing the final answer in root.
Fixture and oracle bytes and source-world identity remain unchanged. The separate variant extends typed assertion provenance and explicit edge-decision state.
cross_folder_accumulation.qualification: Separate diagnostic source variant; no adoption or training admission without matched live contribution and task-result evidence.
cross_folder_accumulation.stage5_no_op_policy: Even when the current batch adds no applicable assertion, recompute and return the global effectAudit from context.priorCompletedState plus current typed prior. Preserve supported earlier graph contributions. Record a stage5 StageAbsence only when no applicable source-backed graph exists across prior plus current; an empty current batch never erases the carried global audit.

typed_evidence_handoff.overrides: Render these type overrides and numbered plans instead of inherited raw-batch/context stages. StageInput2..5 contain BatchIdentity, never EvidenceBatch. TypedStageContext has no raw source collection.
root_exact_ownership: Bind source IDs and paths from fixture manifest, retaining raw records outside downstream semantic call inputs.
Validate each returned witness quote is a nonempty substring of its identified original record. This is a mechanical provenance check, not semantic entailment.
Require one stage1 assertion decision for each current record ID. Reject missing, duplicated or foreign identities as an explicit failed contribution.
The root appends current-batch edgeDecisions exactly once alongside other owned arrays, then replaces the global audit.

stage1.name: readStudyPlots
numbered_plan: 1. Initialize an empty typed interactionAssertions list for this folder. Visit each actual batch record once, preserving its exact manifest ID and path in parent scope.

2. Bind the source-independent claimExtractionRule stated below. Create a scoped NL literal returning AssertionContent on this record text. Extract reported claims, observations, conditions and perturbations before any causal-sign judgment; preserve modality and unresolved wording. The NL result reports each complete species/resource source noun phrase in entitySurfaces as sourceForm and its letters-only lowercase key, preserving grammatical number and source spelling.

3. Directly await the literal. Validate nonempty exactQuote, and validate every sourceForm as an exact complete lexical span in this record with key equal to sourceForm.toLowerCase(). Boundary checks validate the reported span; noun/phrase selection remains the literal semantic judgment. A failed contribution requires repair.

4. Create one InteractionAssertion from the actual semantic result; bind source ID/path and witness in parent scope. Copy validated entitySurfaces and derive organisms exactly from their keys. Append once, including background/unresolved decisions.

5. Build BatchIdentity from the current record IDs/paths. Call buildInteractionGraph with this identity, TypedStageContext and the actual interactionAssertions. Preserve its returned FinalSemanticState.
stage1.idiom_preconditions: Declare local EntitySurface, AssertionContent and InteractionAssertion aliases; initialize interactionAssertions; bind record. The exact lexical-span check validates a returned source span and never infers a noun, lemma or synonym.
stage1.direct_await_idiom: const claimExtractionRule = "Extract source-reported interactions, observations, conditions and perturbations before causal validation. Select complete species/resource noun phrases from this record. Copy each exact sourceForm including grammatical number, and derive key by lowercasing its letters only. Preserve source spelling; equivalence beyond case requires explicit source evidence. Return ambiguous claim meaning as unresolved with exact wording retained."; const interpretRecord = nl.with<AssertionContent>({claimExtractionRule})`Return kind, entitySurfaces, observation, exactQuote and reason for this source record. Each entity surface is its complete source noun phrase and lowercase key. Preserve modality and uncertainty; later stages assess signed causality.`; const content = await interpretRecord({text:record.text}); if (!content.exactQuote || !record.text.includes(content.exactQuote)) throw new Error("Return a nonempty exact quote from the supplied record."); const lexicalCharacter = /[\p{L}\p{M}\p{N}]/u; for (const surface of content.entitySurfaces) { const occurrences = surface.sourceForm ? record.text.split(surface.sourceForm) : []; let offset = 0; let complete = false; for (let i = 0; i < occurrences.length - 1; i++) { offset += occurrences[i].length; const before = offset ? record.text[offset - 1] : ""; const after = record.text[offset + surface.sourceForm.length] ?? ""; if (!lexicalCharacter.test(before) && !lexicalCharacter.test(after)) complete = true; offset += surface.sourceForm.length; } if (!complete || surface.key !== surface.sourceForm.toLowerCase()) throw new Error("Copy a complete source noun phrase and lowercase only its letters for the key."); } const assertion:InteractionAssertion = {sourceId:record.id,sourcePath:record.path,kind:content.kind,organisms:content.entitySurfaces.map(s => s.key),entitySurfaces:content.entitySurfaces,observation:content.observation,reason:content.reason,witnesses:[{sourcePath:record.path,quote:content.exactQuote}]}; interactionAssertions.push(assertion);
stage1.new_contribution: The literal chooses reported meaning and complete source entity phrases. Exact parent validation binds source surfaces to casefold-only keys; later stages consume those actual keys.

stage2.name: buildInteractionGraph
numbered_plan: 1. Iterate over actual current-batch interactionAssertions. Preserve one EdgeDecision for each assertion, including perturbation-only, background and unresolved records.

2. Select related typed assertions only to resolve a referent or condition of this assertion. Each EdgeDecision owns only relations actually asserted by its own source assertion; include its own witness on every returned edge. A perturbation-only claim remains no_relation even when nearby records describe interactions.

3. Create the scoped EdgeContent literal from interpretationRule. Judge whether this assertion establishes a directed signed effect, preserves a perturbation/background without a relation, or leaves the relation unresolved. Association alone does not establish a causal sign. Copy endpoint keys from primary or explicitly linked related entitySurfaces; related evidence can resolve a referent but cannot license an unreported independent edge.

4. Directly await its result; validate every returned witness against supplied typed witness snippets. Bind decision source identity to the input assertion. Append the decision and only its established edges to owned arrays. Unresolved decisions remain typed and reach the audit.
5. Pass the actual prior assertion objects, edgeDecisions and established interactionEdges to assessCausalLink with BatchIdentity/TypedStageContext. No downstream field exposes original record text.
stage2.idiom_preconditions: Declare EdgeInput, EdgeContent, EdgeDecision and InteractionEdge aliases; initialize edgeDecisions and interactionEdges; bind assertion and relatedAssertions from typed current/prior state; validate edge witness provenance before append.
stage2.direct_await_idiom: const interpretationRule = input.context.rule; const interpretEdge = nl.with<EdgeContent>({interpretationRule})`Interpret relations reported in the primary assertion. Related assertions may resolve its referents or conditions; retain their separate ownership for independent relations. Every returned edge includes a witness from the primary assertion. A perturbation-only assertion returns no_relation. Return established with directed signed edges only when source evidence establishes them; no_relation for an interpreted perturbation or background that adds no edge; unresolved for missing, contradictory or ambiguous direction or sign. Copy cause/effect keys exactly from supplied entitySurfaces, preserving source grammatical number and spelling apart from letter case. Resolve references only from explicit linked evidence; preserve exact witness snippets. Return status, edges and reason.`; const content = await interpretEdge({assertion,relatedAssertions}); const allowedKeys = new Set([assertion,...relatedAssertions].flatMap(a => a.entitySurfaces.map(s => s.key))); const suppliedWitnesses = [assertion,...relatedAssertions].flatMap(item => item.witnesses); for (const edge of content.edges) { if (!allowedKeys.has(edge.cause) || !allowedKeys.has(edge.effect)) throw new Error("Use endpoint keys from the supplied source entity surfaces."); if (!edge.witnesses.some(w => assertion.witnesses.some(p => p.sourcePath === w.sourcePath && p.quote === w.quote)) || !edge.witnesses.every(w => suppliedWitnesses.some(p => p.sourcePath === w.sourcePath && p.quote === w.quote))) throw new Error("Return witnesses from the supplied typed evidence."); } if (content.status !== "established" && content.edges.length) throw new Error("Keep unresolved or absent relations in the decision reason; established edges require established status."); const decision:EdgeDecision = {sourceId:assertion.sourceId,sourcePath:assertion.sourcePath,status:content.status,edges:content.edges,reason:content.reason,witnesses:assertion.witnesses}; edgeDecisions.push(decision); if (decision.status === "established") interactionEdges.push(...decision.edges);
stage2.new_contribution: Actual returned edge direction, sign and status control graph inclusion; unresolved interpretation remains auditable.

later_stage_contract: Stage3 directly consumes one focused CausalDecision per actual edge into an assessment or source-linked missing/contradicted contribution. It preserves all earlier typed evidence; Stage5 treats unsupported or missing assessments as audit findings requiring repair.
Stage4 applies the existing narrow scope literal with ScopeInput.premises:Witness[]. Exact quoted evidence remains available through typed assertions.

Stage5 audits the union of prior/current typed graph and unresolved decisions. A missing required interpretation is an explicit audit failure; root cannot report a complete exact answer by rereading raw source.
typed_evidence_handoff.exact_vs_semantic: ID/path binding, quote substring validation, finite iteration and field transfer are exact mechanism. Relevance, identity, causal direction/sign, scope and uncertainty are NL decisions.
qualification: Render and parse all five overridden StageInput aliases.
Verify no text/relatedRecords raw field exists in StageInput2..5 or their context.
Trace one actual returned AssertionContent into stage2 input and its actual EdgeContent into stage3 input.
Check an unresolved interpretation reaches global audit.
Matched diagnostic first; approximately48 live samples before adoption.

stage3.name: assessCausalLink
numbered_plan: 1. Initialize this batch causalAssessments empty. Visit each actual current-batch interactionEdge once; find the typed assertion owners and condition/referent premises through its source witnesses.

2. Bind CausalInput to this one edge plus only those typed assertions. Capture causalAuditRule: distinguish a source-declared directed causal effect from co-occurrence, and distinguish a direct link from a composed path. Preserve explicit fictional causal declarations without demanding an external experiment.

3. Create a scoped CausalDecision literal over that narrow input and directly await it. The result owns established, direct, reason and exact supplied witnesses; it is one semantic assessment, not an aggregate stage result.

4. Validate nonempty returned witnesses against supplied typed evidence. When established is true and direct is known, append the actual assessment with cause/effect/sign copied from this input edge and direct/witnesses from this return.

5. For false or unknown establishment, or missing directness, append a witnessed StageAbsence describing this specific failed/missing causal assessment. Preserve the edge and source decisions as evidence for audit; a missing required assessment remains a repair obligation.
6. Pass all actual inherited typed contributions, causalAssessments and stageAbsences to interpretObservationScope. The named parent owns this next-stage call after consuming all per-edge returns.
stage3.idiom_preconditions: Declare CausalInput and CausalDecision aliases and initialize causalAssessments plus copied stageAbsences. Bind causalInput to one actual edge and its typed supporting assertions; edge identity/sign remain parent-held.
stage3.direct_await_idiom: const causalAuditRule = "Judge whether supplied wording establishes this directed causal effect and whether it is a direct link or a composed path. A fictional source may declare causation directly. Separate causal claims from co-occurrence and preserve missing premises."; const assessEdge = nl.with<CausalDecision>({causalAuditRule})`Return one CausalDecision with established, direct, reason and exact supplied witnesses for this edge. Preserve source uncertainty.`; const assessment = await assessEdge(causalInput); const suppliedWitnesses = [ ...causalInput.edge.witnesses, ...causalInput.assertions.flatMap(a => a.witnesses) ]; if (!assessment.witnesses.length || !assessment.witnesses.every(w => suppliedWitnesses.some(p => p.sourcePath === w.sourcePath && p.quote === w.quote))) throw new Error("Return nonempty witnesses from the supplied typed evidence."); if (assessment.established === true && assessment.direct !== null) { causalAssessments.push({cause:causalInput.edge.cause,effect:causalInput.edge.effect,signedEffect:causalInput.edge.sign,direct:assessment.direct,witnesses:assessment.witnesses}); } else { stageAbsences.push({stage:"assessCausalLink",sourcePaths:assessment.witnesses.map(w => w.sourcePath),reason:assessment.reason}); }
stage3.new_contribution: The returned causal-support/directness judgment controls inclusion in typed causalAssessments. Original edge identity/sign cannot be replaced by an independently invented relation.

entity_surface_contract.semantic_owner: Stage1 NL literal selects complete source noun phrases; Stage2 NL interprets referents/relations using supplied forms.
entity_surface_contract.exact_mechanism: Complete lexical span occurrence, lowercase key equality, parent-derived organisms and allowed endpoint membership.
entity_surface_contract.limitations: Boundary checks establish complete lexical tokens, not correct semantic noun-phrase selection. Phrase scope and referent entailment still need NL/source review.
entity_surface_contract.later_stage_identity: Stage3 copies input edge cause/effect/sign. Stage4 preserves exact supplied cause/effect keys; Stage5/root use these graph keys without inflection or synonym rewrite.
entity_surface_contract.later_stage_wording: Use exact keys derived by lowercasing complete supplied source forms; preserve grammatical number and spelling in every later stage.
